name: Alejandro Sánchez
bio: A student in the Cinematography degree program, they enrolled at the National School of Cinematographic Arts (ENAC) at UNAM in 2023. Currently in their final year of study, they are working on the production of their short film, “RUIDO.” They have taken on various roles, including sound, editing, and directing. They have participated in student productions and several short films at the CCC (Centro de Capacitación Cinematográfica) and within the Faculty of Political and Social Sciences at UNAM.

credits.title: The Offer
credits.overview: Oswaldo, an ordinary man having an ordinary morning... until he tries to order a coffee. That confronts him with the most uncomfortable question of his life: do I accept a coffee based on a misunderstanding, or is this my moment to come out of the closet?

credits.title: Favours After Death
credits.overview: After a young man decides to take his own life while dressed in his best clothes, his tie comes to life, intent on breaking into his neighbour's apartment to seek help.

credits.title: While I Wait
credits.overview: A young man races against time to find and finish writing a book so he can hand it over to a higher entity and be judged.
